Overall Experience:
Honestly, CSE323 with SSI sir was kind of mixed for me. A lot of the time I personally couldn’t fully understand his lectures, and sometimes he himself seemed a bit confused while explaining. But one good thing is that he was fairly generous with grading, so in the end most students were satisfied with their grades. So if you get him, I’d say you can take the course without worrying too much.
Another thing I noticed is that he appreciates students who actually try in class. If he sees someone responding, asking questions, or at least trying to understand the topic, he usually gives a decent curve.
Class & Attendance
Even though his teaching style may not be everyone’s favorite, he often gives important hints and suggestions during class about exams and important topics. Those small hints actually help a lot later, so attending classes regularly is a good idea.
Also, attendance was worth 10%, so missing too many classes could hurt your marks.
Quizzes & Exams
There were 3 quizzes in total, but only the best 2 counted. Most quiz questions were pretty direct and mainly came from the slides and assignments.
But the midterm and final were a different story. The questions were much trickier, and a few questions even came from topics that weren’t properly covered in class. Because of that, self-study was super important for this course. Honestly, I had to learn many things on my own outside class.
I somehow managed to get an A-, but it definitely required a lot of effort and practice by myself.
Project
The project section was actually one of the chill parts of the course. I did most of my project using Gemini’s help and still got a pretty good grade. There wasn’t any in-class presentation either.
After finishing the project, we had to record a screen-recorded video (maximum 5 minutes) explaining the project features with our own voice. The time limit was strict, so the video couldn’t go over 5 minutes.
Then we had to upload the video to YouTube (private or public, both were okay). The project code also had to be uploaded to GitHub, and the YouTube video link needed to be added there too.
Finally, both the GitHub link and YouTube link had to be included in the report, and we only had to submit the report on Canvas.

I did cse115 and cse323, both under NVA. I am sharing my experience here for those students who are still confused about considering her. If you dont wanna read the whole thing, the moral is dont take her.
Depending of my experience in cse115 i took her again for cse323. But that was a mistake. In cse115 she actually did teach though I learned most things from YouTube and got an A. But cse323 is not like cse115. The course is very broad and you wont realize that she actually taught nothing until you're done with the semester.... She just skimmed from the top. Though she expects that you'll study on your own and go in-depth. But that's pointless because she'll give questions from the slides she'll teach in class, then again.... Those are like every other slides. She'll basically tell a thing or two from each slide and move on. So before exams you'll realize that you have to learn a lot of things from YouTube for everything to make sense.
A lot of the students will give advices like "just follow her instructions". Let me tell you... You're still not safe even if you follow all her instructions.
She'll take 3 presentations in this course. We got full marks and bonus too in 2 presentations but got zero in the other one. The reason was... She came in early that day and started the class at the exact time, we were 5-6 mins late and a presentation was already going on so we waited outside for them to finish their presentation.. when we were about to enter after they were done. She ousted us from the class and when we tried to explain that we were 5-6 mins late and didn't enter because a presentation was already going on, she got angry again and started yelling "tumi onnoder presentation dekhte na chaile, tomar o dorkar nai presentation dewar. Eishob fatrami amar class'e cholbena."
She'll take a lot of class assessments, usually on the things she taught in the previous class or that class. She didn't accept one of my assessment and was about to do the same with another one but later accepted. Let me tell you guys what had happened. She taught us an algorithm "reader-writer" and told us to modify it at home. In the next class she didn't mention anything about it and so i thought she didn't mean that thing as assessment. When the class ended she told us to submit that and since I had already taken notes on the back page. I copied my answer on a fresh page and went to submit it. She didn't take it as she assumed I wrote it class and not home and started yelling.
Then the other incident, me and my friend both went to submit out script on memory segmentation. She took our scripts and started to check and later called us and told us to take away our scripts because we cheated. How? The last memory address for both of us were same. Then told us to leave her classroom as there were no place for cheaters like us in her classroom. I tried to explain that this address will be the same for everyone. But she wont listen.. and had started yelling.
We stood outside and asked each and everyone who came out if they had the same value or not... That value was same for the whole class.
Since we sat beside in class. And went to her to submit our scripts together, she assumed we cheated and was basically looking for any hint that we cheated. While doing so she forgot the basics of memory segmentation...
Then we again went to her after the class ended, this time she just asked "cheating koronai" we replied "no". She accepted our scripts.
Btw I still ended up with a good grade but would've been better. Let me explain how... She only showed us our midterm and quiz copies. I had several questions about midterm marking. When i went to her she dismissed me saying that I am a chagol where as my friend wrote the exact same thing and got a better mark in that question. Then she kept the copy away and didn't let me finish my queries and told me to move on. Then that presentation that she didn't let us present for being "late" but she accepted project demonstration from other group even on the day of final. Which was 1 week after our project demonstration dateline.. she didn't let us present for being 5-6 mins late... But on the day of other presentations she let students get in, who were 15-20 mins late.
Then the final script... She checked all our final scripts within 1 hour of our final exam and had already uploaded the marks to canvas. After seeing that two of my friends went and found that she did calculation mistakes, had skipped pages, gave less marks on question that weighted more marks for no reason. hence their marks increased. She gave an announcement to come to her room to check the scripts before grade submission. When I went she took signature on a sheet, beside the grade that I had achieved. Then when I asked to check the scripts, she said this is already a good grade so checking the scripts wont matter as even if my marks increased, my grade wouldn't improve and didn't let me see the scripts..
I can keep going on... But ig this much is enough to help you guys truly understand of what you'll be stepping into. It's not as simple as "Just follow her instructions".
